question: Can a publication-lagged authentic historically dated H4.1 Fed balance sheet factor describe BTC price structural transitions beyond the BTC-only v8.9 baseline, without look-ahead?
releaseDiscovery: All EXACT historical H.4.1 release date HTML page links from index between 2011-01-01 and 2026-10-15 inclusive, including irregular holidays. No assuming Thursdays or interpolating missing dates.
sourceIntegrity: Fetch HTTPS FED official dated release HTML. Verify release date, H4.1 and exact table 5 consolidated statement sections, parse Wednesday LEVEL numbers from table 5 for Total assets, Treasury General Account and reverse repurchase agreements. In millions USD. Any ambiguous parsing => MISSING_SOURCE and no feature for affected week. Retain source URL, SHA256, raw HTML in run-scoped R2 for full dataset only if parsed. Distinguish current copy of dated release from incontrovertible original PIT vintage.
exactRowRules: Only 5. Consolidated Statement of Condition of All Federal Reserve Banks (assets and continued liabilities). Do not accidentally parse week-average from Table 1 or 12-bank per-bank table 6. Row label and numeric are matched by anchored regular expression. Verify numeric positive and sensible to Fed level and TGA/RRP<=total.
prototype: First run pilot with preregistered six dated sample releases from v8.9a: 2011-10-20,2017-10-19,2020-10-22,2022-10-20,2024-10-17,2025-10-16. Validate exact known Oct2020 table5 figures WALCL 7,177,265 TGA 1,699,497 RRP 187,435 (millions).
feature: Research-only simplified level = Fed total assets - TGA - total reverse repurchase agreements; 4-release difference in millions. Do NOT call this true net liquidity or monetary base, because extra flows/items and government Treasury balances may affect other fields. Positive/negative sign. One feature per Sunday, using last eligible release dated <= Sunday - 3 calendar days (conservative lag; insufficient to prove historical page vintage).
publication: Release dated Thursday generally 16:30 America/New_York; features available at following FULL Sunday close. Require release date<=Sunday - 3 calendar days to account for Thu->Sun; official holiday shifted dates Fri may be delayed to next Sunday and should not be used early.
weekAlignment: Join only exact v8.9 full Sunday dates, never future rows. Features missing before >=5 accepted releases; no silent carry-forward after release gaps >21 days. Read no future BTC price in classification.
comparison: Tabulate 4 and 13 week future BTC returns from frozen v8.9 weekly context, 29 structural switch events grouped by macro rising/falling based on LAST known release, and 13wk next outcomes. Also weekly-by-structural-phase macro sign counts to assess coverage. All overlapping futures and macro endogenous to policy/time; descriptive not causal or alpha.
holdout: No independent untouched future market observations; predeclared 2024-2026 subperiod is not true holdout and signal not validated. Sign/direction unoptimized; do not fit weights or trade thresholds.
limits: No invented number for missing release or pre-release week
NFCI ALFRED true revisions still not joined in this run
Farside ETF historic publication vintage unresolved, not included
No changes to NAV, Spot, Futures, portfolio, capital, risk, MASTER or trading
